description: This file contains functions related to setting up and managing display hardware devices using the DRM (Direct Rendering Manager) subsystem on Linux. It includes functions for initializing connectors, encoders, CRTCs, planes, and cleaning up resources, tailored specifically for managing hardware display components.

methods.name: kms_setup_encoder
methods.description: Initializes the encoder by selecting a suitable encoder from the list, matching encoder IDs, and setting the CRTC accordingly.

methods.name: kms_setup_connector
methods.description: Finds an active connector with available modes and connected status, and assigns it to the context.

methods.name: kms_setup_crtc
methods.description: Sets up the CRTC associated with the encoder, validating mode and updating current display info.

methods.name: kms_setup
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the kms_ctx structure, setting up connector, encoder, and CRTC.

methods.name: kms_cleanup_context
methods.description: Frees all resources associated with the kms_ctx, including connector, encoder, CRTC, and resources.

methods.name: kms_get_properties
methods.description: Retrieves the property ID for a given property name on a DRM object.

methods.name: kms_get_plane
methods.description: Enumerates display planes, identifies primary and overlay planes, and stores their IDs.
